desc: Features patented Memory-flex™ flexible aircraft cable cleaning rods in 32" and 6" pistol versions, along with a 24" .177 caliber Memory-flex™ rod that cleans pellet and BB guns. This kit also contains 5 deluxe brass Supra Tine™ micro-fiber cleaning brushes covering .177 to .54 cal., three different-sized solid brass slotted patch tips, two brass bore obstruction removers, two shotgun barrel patch savers, solvent/lubricant/preserve, fiber optic bore illuminator, all caliber cleaning patches, and a rod connector.
